transfer.nativeReceiveInstruction: Copy the sender's numeric LAN address 192.168.x.x:PORT to your clipboard. Select the verified device.
transfer.nativeInternetDisclosure: Internet mode explicitly uses third-party n0 DNS/Pkarr discovery and encrypted relay fallback. The provider may see IPs and timing metadata, not QUIC contents. Confirm the peer ID independently.
transfer.pairNoNetwork: Manual pin only. No connection, file access, or Vault permission is granted. A future Iroh QUIC connection must authenticate this exact key.
transfer.pairObserved: Full peer EndpointId from invitation (64 lowercase hex characters)
transfer.pairVerified: Full EndpointId separately checked on the other device or via an independent call. Do not copy the first field here.
transfer.pairRevokeWarning: Permanent revocation: this peer cannot be silently paired again. Verify the complete key:
transfer.pairIdle: No peer record checked. Verify both full IDs before saving a manual pin.
transfer.pairNotFound: No stored record for that peer key.
transfer.pairConfirmed: Peer public key manually pinned in OS credentials. No active QUIC connection is authenticated.
transfer.pairRevoked: Peer public key is permanently revoked for future transfers.
transfer.pairConfirm: Confirm and pin expected peer key
transfer.pairRevokeChanged: Revocation cancelled: the peer ID changed or independent verification is missing.
transfer.pairInvalidComparison: Enter two matching, complete, lowercase EndpointIds from independently verified sources.
transfer.pairInvalidObserved: Enter a complete, lowercase 64-character Iroh EndpointId.
transfer.nativeReceiveWorking: Authenticating, receiving and verifying one file…
transfer.nativeReceiveSuccess: Verified file stored in Received Inbox.
transfer.nativeSendInternetReady: n0 Internet discovery ready. Receiver selects the independently confirmed peer ID without a LAN address.
transfer.nativeSendChoose: Add exactly one file to the queue.
transfer.nativeSendWaiting: Waiting for receiver. Share your LAN IP and the displayed UDP port.
transfer.nativeSendSuccess: Receiver verified the file. Not a durable acknowledgement.
transfer.nativeSendWarning: Confirmed peers only. No Notes Vault access.

server.title: Your server · setup draft
server.stateHint: First installation of Akula Node on your own Linux server. No connection or remote change has occurred.
server.hostHint: DNS host or IPv4. Draft fields do not run SSH.
server.portHint: Usually 22. No connection is started here.
server.userHint: A nonprivileged account whose sudo rights must be independently checked.
server.publicKeyHint: Only ssh-ed25519 AAAA... obtained independently from the provider console, never a private key.
server.fingerprintHint: Enter the separately obtained SSH fingerprint SHA256:...; it must match the public host key.
server.offlineCheckHint: Only checks the two manually entered values. This is not remote authentication or proof that the server is available.
server.pinConsistent: Host key and SHA-256 match · SSH not verified yet
server.pinIncomplete: No matching host key and fingerprint

server.noCredentials: Secrets are neither accepted nor stored
server.verifyHint: Disabled until protected Windows OpenSSH transport, real owner approval and the Linux installer pass security acceptance.

yandex.title: Yandex Object Storage · setup
yandex.explanationHint: This is a safe setup draft. No S3 credentials are entered in Akula, no remote identity has been verified, and synchronization remains disabled.
yandex.stepAccountHint: Open Yandex Cloud, then create a dedicated service account for the private bucket. Do not use your personal account keys.
yandex.stepKeyHint: Use the service account to create an Access Key ID and Secret Access Key. Never paste either key into this setup draft.
yandex.stepBucketHint: Use a unique, non-public bucket and grant the service account only the permissions it needs. Buckets and S3 API requests may be billed.
yandex.bucketHint: Enter only the bucket name from the console, then press Enter to save this local draft. Do not paste a URL or access key.
yandex.profileHint: Enter the name of an external credentials profile, for example akula-yandex; press Enter. Do not enter credentials in this field.
yandex.profileHelpHint: Until the secure operating-system keychain and S3 verification are implemented, follow the official AWS CLI setup instructions. The named profile is not consumed by sync yet.
yandex.endpointHint: Fixed HTTPS endpoint for the initial Yandex connection; not user-editable.
yandex.regionHint: Default region for Yandex Object Storage.
yandex.credentialSafetyHint: Akula must store secret keys in the OS credential store, not ordinary settings JSON, before an in-app key form can be enabled.
yandex.neverPasteKeys: Never paste Secret Access Key into these fields
yandex.connectionTestHint: This button will be enabled only after secure credential storage, a bounded read-only S3 probe and explicit remote trust verification are implemented. Preparing this form never starts sync.

sync.s3BoundHint: Uses the locally registered S3 profile and cloud VaultId, not the local workspace UUID. This is not proof of owner identity, file durability or remote synchronization.
sync.s3BoundNotConfigured: Registered S3 profile or receive journal unavailable
sync.s3BoundNoClaims: No pending local S3 receive claims (not proof of sync)
sync.s3BoundUnavailable: S3-bound local review unavailable — fail closed
sync.s3BoundNoAck: The file might exist, but there is no native durable receipt, remote ACK or ConfirmedBaseline. No retry, overwrite or delete.
sync.s3BoundHistoricalPath: Historical cloud operation path, not a promise about the current file. No review action is authorized here.
sync.title: Sync recovery · read-only
sync.noVaultHint: Select a registered knowledge base before inspecting recovery records.
sync.notConfiguredHint: No initialized Sync operations journal was found in application data. This does not mean devices are synchronized.
sync.noClaims: No local publication claims in this journal
sync.noClaimsHint: This is not a verification of remote state, complete backups or cross-device consistency.
sync.pendingHint: {{count}} durable publication attempts require investigation. Listed names are historical journal paths.
sync.failedHint: The journal, registered vault or schema could not be verified. No automatic database repair or file changes are allowed.
sync.historicalPathHint: Historical name from the local operation journal; the current on-disk file may differ.
sync.moreHint: {{count}} additional journal paths are not displayed.
sync.retentionHint: Copies may contain unencrypted Markdown or attachments in app-data. No automatic deletion is permitted.
sync.safetyHint: Automatic retry, cleanup, replacement, confirmed baseline and physical quarantine are disabled. No operator approvals are available yet.
sync.assessmentHint: Historical evidence, not proof of which process created the file.
sync.fingerprintHint: A checksum of the first durable incident and forensic copies. A matching checksum does not prove file ownership.
sync.reviewCountHint: A concurrent review invalidates this screen; inspect the case again.
sync.reviewActionHint: Both choices keep the original files, forensic copies and all Sync blocks. They never restore, delete, replace or confirm anything.
sync.reviewUnavailable: This case cannot be reviewed until immutable evidence and archived copies are verified. No changes made.
sync.reviewStale: The case has changed or is unavailable. Reinspect before confirming; no changes made.
sync.confirmDescription: Case: {{path}}. Previous reviews: {{sequence}}. Choice: {{action}}. This only adds a local audit event, preserves all files, does not authenticate a human user and does not activate synchronization. Confirm explicitly.
sync.reviewRecorded: Review event {{sequence}} recorded. All original files and sync blocks remain unchanged.
